import time, psutil, base64, asyncio
def mem():
    return psutil.Process().memory_info().rss // 1024 // 1024
print("START_RAM_MB", mem(), flush=True)
import edge_tts
async def make_ref():
    await edge_tts.Communicate("Hello there! This is a test of my voice. I am speaking nice and clearly so the computer can learn exactly how I sound. Listen to my tone, my pitch, my rhythm.", "en-US-AvaNeural", pitch="+15Hz", rate="+0%").save("/tmp/ref.mp3")
asyncio.run(make_ref())
print("REF_DONE", flush=True)
from chatterbox.tts import ChatterboxTTS
t0=time.time()
model = ChatterboxTTS.from_pretrained(device="cpu")
print("MODEL_LOAD_SEC", round(time.time()-t0,1), flush=True)
print("RAM_AFTER_LOAD_MB", mem(), flush=True)
t0=time.time()
wav = model.generate("Hey Boo! This voice was cloned by your cloud PC. Pretty amazing, right? I am speaking with a brand new voice!", audio_prompt_path="/tmp/ref.mp3")
print("INFERENCE_SEC", round(time.time()-t0,1), flush=True)
print("RAM_AFTER_INFER_MB", mem(), flush=True)
import torchaudio
torchaudio.save("/tmp/cloned.wav", wav.unsqueeze(0), model.sr)
audio=open("/tmp/cloned.wav","rb").read()
print("CLONED_BYTES", len(audio))
print("---CLONED_B64---")
print(base64.b64encode(audio).decode())
print("DONE")
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/clone_test2.py
